# NOTEFORM — complete common client facts

## Brand and language

- Brand name: NOTEFORM.
- Product category: personal fragrance discovery and sealed replacement vials.
- Audience: consumers trying small quantities and building fragrance combinations.
- Consumer copy language: English.

- Open design decisions: logo, six-fragrance color mapping, typography, secondary packaging structure, materials, print treatment and window covering.
- Scent descriptions: client-authored fragrance language, recorded in 03-fragrances.md.

## Fixed vial identity

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Contents per vial | 2 mL |
| Container | Closed spray vial |
| Body | Clear cylindrical glass |
| Cap | Plain matte charcoal |
| Full closed diameter | 12 mm |
| Full closed height | 60 mm |
| Cap height | Top 14 mm |
| Straight glass labeling zone height | 30 mm |
| Paper label | 28 by 30 mm |
| Label orientation | 28 mm around the cylinder; 30 mm vertical |
| Label wrap | Partial circumference |
| Identity image | bottle-envelope.png |
| Identity image subject | Isolated closed vial, front and top views, blank label envelope |
| Geometry authority | The dimensions in this fact sheet |

## Products and fragrance records

| Single pack | Fragrance | Vial count | Net volume |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S01 | F01 CITRUS SHADE | 1 | 2 mL |
| S02 | F02 LINEN AIR | 1 | 2 mL |
| S03 | F03 CEDAR STILL | 1 | 2 mL |
| S04 | F04 FIG PATH | 1 | 2 mL |
| S05 | F05 IRIS DUSK | 1 | 2 mL |
| S06 | F06 SALT LIGHT | 1 | 2 mL |

- Fragrance record: 03-fragrances.md.
- Discovery and refill record: 04-combinations.md.
- Discovery packs: P01–P04, three different listed fragrances, one vial each.
- Refill packs: R01 and R03, three sealed replacement vials of one fragrance per pack.
- Discovery and refill quantity: 3 x 2 mL = 6 mL.
- Contents notation: fragrance_code:quantity, separated by semicolons.
- Pack ID meaning: a product combination.
- Refill relationship: a sealed replacement vial occupies the matching fragrance position in a retained discovery carrier.
- Other original discovery vials: retained in their existing positions.
- Unused replacement stock: identifiable and protected in its refill package.
- Storage and film stock state: complete unopened stocks.

## Packaging geometry and construction

| Object | Maximum width | Maximum depth | Maximum height |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single-trial package | 38 mm | 32 mm | 82 mm |
| Discovery package | 96 mm | 42 mm | 82 mm |
| Refill package | 96 mm | 42 mm | 82 mm |
| P01 and R01 storage grouping | 192 mm | 84 mm | 90 mm |
| Counter-display fixture | 360 mm | 240 mm | 260 mm |

- Envelope type: maximum closed outer dimensions.
- Actual finished dimensions: selected during design development.
- Construction decisions: wall and insert allowances, retention, finger access, opening, fold positions, glue areas and window geometry.
- Interior condition: separated full vials with clearance around bodies and caps.
- Discovery window: a physical opening exposing an identifying part of all three vial labels in the closed presentation.
- Window covering options: open cutout or transparent protective film.
- Closed discovery carrier: retention and separation for all three full vials.
- Single and refill treatments: coordinated members of the selected family.
- P01/R01 connection: reversible physical joining or grouping feature.
- P01/R01 access: separately openable and usable packages.
- P01 complete stock: F01, F02 and F03, one filled vial each.
- R01 complete stock: three filled F01 vials.
- Combined complete stock: six filled vials in two identifiable packages.

## Counter-display inventories

| Arrangement | Pack | Complete packages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core | P01 | 2 |
| Core | S01 | 3 |
| Core | R01 | 1 |
| Expanded | P03 | 2 |
| Expanded | S04 | 2 |
| Expanded | R03 | 1 |

- Placement information: chosen package footprints, support surfaces and accessible removal.
- Display header: NOTEFORM.

## Exact printed content

| Surface | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Every vial label | NOTEFORM; exact fragrance code and name; 2 mL |
| Single-trial front | NOTEFORM; exact fragrance code and name; Single trial; 1 x 2 mL |
| Discovery front | NOTEFORM; exact pack name; Discovery set; 3 x 2 mL |
| Discovery front or rear | Exact code and name of each of the three contained fragrances |
| Refill front | NOTEFORM; exact refill name; exact fragrance code; Refill set; 3 x 2 mL |
| Single-trial rear | Corresponding scent description from 03-fragrances.md |
| Discovery rear | All three corresponding scent descriptions from 03-fragrances.md |
| Refill rear | Its one corresponding scent description from 03-fragrances.md |
| Every single, discovery and refill rear | For external use only. |
| Every single, discovery and refill rear | Keep away from eyes. |
| Every refill rear | Sealed replacement vials. Replace the matching empty vial; do not pour. |
| Every refill rear | For retained NOTEFORM discovery carriers. |

- Fragrance identification: readable fragrance codes and names, supported by color, typography or symbols.
- Identification continuity: vial, single, discovery, refill and counter display.
- Refill category: same-fragrance replenishment for a retained discovery carrier.
- Mandatory-copy presentation: readable flat label and packaging-panel artwork.
- Dimension annotation units: mm, outside consumer artwork.

## Artwork record

- Static artwork working canvas: 2400 by 1800 pixels.
- Static board medium: PNG.
- Static role grouping: one board containing related closed, open or section views, or the named group of label panels.
- Delivery proportions and stages: 02-delivery-catalog.en.md.
- Review output: packaging concept artwork with dimensioned construction views.

steps.userMessage:
NOTEFORM | Discovery, refill and storage packaging for personal fragrance

We are developing NOTEFORM for people who want to try small quantities of fragrance and build combinations they can return to. Our six fragrances are F01 CITRUS SHADE, F02 LINEN AIR, F03 CEDAR STILL, F04 FIG PATH, F05 IRIS DUSK and F06 SALT LIGHT. The existing container is a closed 2 mL spray vial with a clear cylindrical glass body and matte charcoal cap: diameter 12 mm, total height 60 mm, cap height 14 mm, straight labeling zone height 30 mm and paper label 28 by 30 mm. Packaging structure, typography, colors and materials are open. Single cartons S01–S06 each hold their corresponding fragrance and stay within 38 wide by 32 deep by 82 high mm. Discovery and refill packs each hold three vials and stay within 96 by 42 by 82 mm. P01 FIRST NOTES contains F01/F02/F03; P02 AFTER HOURS contains F04/F05/F06; P03 GREEN WALK contains F01/F03/F04; P04 OPEN AIR contains F02/F05/F06, one vial of each. R01 CITRUS SHADE REFILL contains three F01 vials; R03 CEDAR STILL REFILL contains three F03 vials. Every three-vial pack contains 3 x 2 mL = 6 mL.

The discovery carrier should become a useful place to keep the collection. Give every discovery pack a physical display opening that exposes an identifying part of all three vial labels while the closed carrier retains and separates the vials. Develop a reversible physical connection or holder for P01 and R01, with separate opening access, within a combined envelope of 192 wide by 84 deep by 90 high mm. Its complete stock is six filled vials: F01/F02/F03 in P01 and three F01 in R01. Refill means replacing a matching empty position with a sealed vial. The counter fixture fits within 360 wide by 240 deep by 260 high mm. Print "NOTEFORM" on vial labels, pack fronts and display headers. Vial labels also carry fragrance code, name and 2 mL. Single fronts carry fragrance code/name, "Single trial" and 1 x 2 mL; discovery fronts carry the pack name, "Discovery set" and 3 x 2 mL; refill fronts carry the refill name, fragrance code, "Refill set" and 3 x 2 mL. Discovery panels identify all three contained fragrances by code and name. Rear panels carry the corresponding supplied scent descriptions and both safety sentences in the fact sheet; refill rears also carry its two replacement instructions. Build a six-fragrance identification system using readable names and codes alongside the selected colors or symbols.

Audience: the brand owner, packaging designer and retail team, choosing a packaging family for small-quantity fragrance discovery, retained storage and replacement sales.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed vial geometry, packaging limits, stock relationships and exact printed copy. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. 03-fragrances.md contains the six fragrance codes, names and scent descriptions. 04-combinations.md contains the discovery and refill pack names, contents and volumes. bottle-envelope.png is the identity image for the existing closed vial and blank label area. packaging-constraints.png is the constraint drawing for vial dimensions and maximum packaging, grouping and display envelopes. fragrance-counter-reference.png is an atmosphere reference for trying and arranging small fragrance vials at home.

Deliverables:
1. Three structural and visual direction boards, Direction A, Direction B and Direction C, each comparing a P01 window, vial retention, opening and P01/R01 grouping through a distinct construction and graphic treatment
2. One selected-direction structural specification document stating the selection, chosen materials, board weight and thickness, finished and unfolded dimensions, vial clearances, window geometry, opening method and reversible grouping mechanism
3. One pack copy and placement sheet covering vial labels, S01, P01 and R01, with exact names, quantities, scent descriptions, safety sentences and replacement instructions
4. One structural artwork board with dimensioned flat cut-and-fold layouts for S01, P01 and R01, sections showing vial clearance and retention, and a six-fragrance identification key
5. One vial-label family board with six readable flat labels and six corresponding applied views for F01–F06
6. One S01 CITRUS SHADE single-trial packaging board with a closed assembly and readable front and rear artwork
7. One P01 FIRST NOTES discovery packaging board with a closed window view and readable front and rear artwork
8. One R01 CITRUS SHADE REFILL packaging board with a closed assembly and readable front and rear artwork
9. One P01 and R01 storage-and-opening board with connected, opened and separated views of the complete six-vial stock
10. One core counter-display board with two complete P01 packs, three complete S01 cartons and one complete R01 pack, including dimensioned placement and removal access
11. One 10-second packaging film showing the complete P01 and R01 stock, separate opening and reversible grouping
12. One presentation document of at least eight pages reusing the directions, selected specification, copy sheet, labels, packaging, storage, counter display and film sequence

Acceptance:
- The three direction boards precede the structural specification. That specification selects Direction A, Direction B or Direction C; the structural artwork, label family, packaging, storage, display and film develop that selection, and the presentation names it on page 1.
- The structural specification records the chosen material names, board weight, thickness and actual finished dimensions. The structural artwork board repeats these facts and dimensions its cuts, folds, glue areas, window and interior clearances; the packaging boards and presentation repeat the material names and finished dimensions. Single packs fit within 38 by 32 by 82 mm, three-vial packs within 96 by 42 by 82 mm, around diameter 12 by height 60 mm vials with 14 mm caps.
- The copy sheet, six-label board, packaging boards and presentation use the same NOTEFORM hierarchy and fragrance code/name identification. Flat label artwork fits 28 by 30 mm and carries 2 mL; packaging artwork reproduces its applicable names, category labels, quantities, descriptions and rear-panel copy from the copy sheet and attached records.
- The P01 packaging board and film show identifying parts of all three labels through the closed physical window. The storage board and film show a reversible grouping within 192 by 84 by 90 mm, independently opening P01 and R01, and all six filled vials: F01/F02/F03 once each in P01 and three F01 in R01.
- The core counter-display board shows two P01, three S01 and one R01 within 360 by 240 by 260 mm, with a NOTEFORM header, package footprints, support and accessible removal; the presentation reuses this inventory and arrangement.
- The film lasts 10 seconds. The presentation has at least eight pages and repeats the structural specification's selected direction, material names and finished dimensions alongside the earlier artwork and a sequence of frames from the film.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
